name: app-dark-analytics-dashboard-on-monitor-with-orange-accents
title: Dark analytics dashboard on a monitor with orange highlights, arc bars and donut charts
whatItIs: A monitor showing a black dashboard with a left menu, greeting, a big orange tile, stat cards, arch-shaped bar charts, donut rings and a ranked product list with orange and grey accents, against a red-black gradient.
whatItMeans: Bold and technical; orange on black feels like a performance console.
techniques: Use one orange for key tiles.
Keep secondary charts grey and white.
Stage the monitor on a red glow.

vocabulary.definition: Bars with rounded tops shaped like arches.
One tile in the accent colour.
A desktop screen in a scene.
